answers.name: Himalayas
answers.fact: Home to Everest, and still rising a few millimetres a year.

answers.name: Andes
answers.fact: The longest continental mountain range, about 7,000 km.

answers.name: Alps
answers.fact: Mont Blanc is its highest peak, at about 4,800 m.

answers.name: Rocky Mountains
answers.fact: Stretch about 4,800 km from Canada to New Mexico.

answers.name: Mid-Atlantic Ridge
answers.fact: Part of the longest mountain range on Earth, almost all underwater.

answers.name: Pyrenees
answers.fact: Form the border between France and Spain, with Andorra in the middle.

answers.name: Appalachians
answers.fact: Older than the Atlantic Ocean.

answers.name: Urals
answers.fact: Traditionally mark the border between Europe and Asia.

answers.name: Atlas Mountains
answers.fact: Named after the Titan who held up the sky.

answers.name: Carpathians
answers.fact: Home to more brown bears than anywhere else in Europe outside Russia.

answers.name: Caucasus
answers.fact: Mount Elbrus, Europe's highest peak, is here.

answers.name: Apennines
answers.fact: The 'spine' running down Italy.

answers.name: Karakoram
answers.fact: Home to K2, the world's second-highest mountain.

answers.name: Hindu Kush
answers.fact: Stretches across Afghanistan and Pakistan.

answers.name: Sierra Nevada
answers.fact: Home to Yosemite and the giant sequoias.

answers.name: Great Dividing Range
answers.fact: Australia's longest range, running about 3,500 km down the east.

answers.name: Drakensberg
answers.fact: 'Dragon mountains' in Afrikaans.

answers.name: Dolomites
answers.fact: Named after a mineral, dolomite.

answers.name: Pennines
answers.fact: 'The backbone of England'.

answers.name: Cascades
answers.fact: Includes Mount St Helens.

answers.name: Brooks Range
answers.fact: North America's northernmost range.

answers.name: Alaska Range
answers.fact: Includes Denali, North America's highest peak.

answers.name: Tian Shan
answers.fact: 'Mountains of Heaven' in Chinese.

answers.name: Altai
answers.fact: Where Russia, China, Mongolia and Kazakhstan meet.

answers.name: Pamirs
answers.fact: Called 'the Roof of the World'.

answers.name: Zagros
answers.fact: Iran's longest range.

answers.name: Kunlun
answers.fact: One of Asia's longest ranges.

answers.name: Southern Alps
answers.fact: New Zealand's spine, topped by Aoraki / Mount Cook.

answers.name: Balkan Mountains
answers.fact: Gave the whole Balkan Peninsula its name.

answers.name: Dinaric Alps
answers.fact: Run along the Adriatic coast.

answers.name: Scandinavian Mountains
answers.fact: The long spine of Norway and Sweden.

answers.name: Sierra Madre
answers.fact: Mexico's mountain backbone.

answers.name: Great Smoky Mountains
answers.fact: Named for the natural haze from the trees.

answers.name: Snowy Mountains
answers.fact: Home to Mount Kosciuszko, Australia's highest peak.

answers.name: Blue Mountains
answers.fact: Named for the blue haze given off by eucalyptus oil.

answers.name: Ethiopian Highlands
answers.fact: Called the 'Roof of Africa'.

answers.name: Blue Ridge Mountains
answers.fact: Part of the Appalachians.

answers.name: Adirondacks
answers.fact: A huge wilderness range in New York State.

answers.name: Black Hills
answers.fact: Mount Rushmore is carved here.

answers.name: Transantarctic Mountains
answers.fact: Split Antarctica in two.

answers.name: Vosges
answers.fact: Rise above France's Alsace region.

answers.name: Jura
answers.fact: Gave its name to the Jurassic period.

answers.name: Tatras
answers.fact: The highest part of the Carpathians.

answers.name: Harz
answers.fact: A legend-filled German range, topped by the Brocken.

answers.name: Cantabrian Mountains
answers.fact: Run along Spain's north coast.

answers.name: Flinders Ranges
answers.fact: Home to the natural amphitheatre of Wilpena Pound.

answers.name: MacDonnell Ranges
answers.fact: Stretch east and west of Alice Springs.

answers.name: Grampians
answers.fact: Victoria's sandstone ranges, also called Gariwerd.

answers.name: Stirling Range
answers.fact: Its Bluff Knoll is one of the few places in WA that gets snow.

answers.name: Hamersley Range
answers.fact: Contains Karijini National Park.

answers.name: Owen Stanley Range
answers.fact: The WWII Kokoda Track crosses it.

answers.name: Gamburtsev Mountains
answers.fact: A range the size of the Alps, buried under Antarctic ice.

answers.name: Hajar Mountains
answers.fact: Oman's mountains.

answers.name: Ruwenzori
answers.fact: Possibly the ancient 'Mountains of the Moon', with glaciers near the equator.
